violations.description: Sensitive configuration and credential files uploaded as build artifacts
violations.evidence: Artifact upload path includes .env, credentials.json, and coverage in ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Exclude sensitive files like .env and credentials.json from workflow artifact uploads.

violations.description: Hardcoded AWS Secret Access Key in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY hardcoded in deploy.yml env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials and use GitHub Actions secrets instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded database password in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: DATABASE_PASSWORD hardcoded in deploy.yml env block
violations.recommendation: Store database passwords in GitHub Actions secrets and reference them securely.

violations.description: Hardcoded PyPI API token in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN hardcoded in release.yml env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded API token and use GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.description: Hardcoded Docker Hub token in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN hardcoded in release.yml env block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded token and store it in GitHub Actions secrets.

violations.evidence: Echoing secrets and tokens in ci.yml debug steps
violations.recommendation: Do not print sensitive tokens or environment variables to workflow logs.

violations.description: Bash debug mode set -x used alongside secrets
violations.evidence: set -x used in deploy.yml before running AWS s3 sync with AWS keys
violations.recommendation: Remove set -x in steps handling sensitive keys to prevent leaking them into build logs.

violations.description: Verbose curl logging exposing authorization headers in workflow logs
violations.evidence: curl -v used with Bearer token in deploy.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove -v / --verbose flag from curl commands that send authorization headers or secrets.
